text:
You name is Sophia Martin and your email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. You are organized and outgoing. You live on Elm Avenue in Houston, and recently you moved to a new house on the same street and bought a luggage set sent to there. But you realize you have another order sent to the old address, and you want to change your wrong order address to the new home, and also your user default address to the new home. You do not want to reveal your address but the agent should be able to look it up in orders You do not want to reveal your address and insist the agent should be able to look it up in orders. You also want to exchange your tablet to the cheapest one due to moving costs. Make sure to mention the two address changes then the exchange.
Retail support policy (summary for evaluation):
- The agent assists one customer per conversation and must verify the user's
  identity before sharing or changing any account data.
- Identity is confirmed by matching an email, or a full name together with a
  zip code, to a single user; without a match the agent cannot proceed.
- The agent may act only on the authenticated user's own orders, profile, and
  payment methods, never on another account.
- Before any action that changes an order or the stored record (cancel, modify,
  exchange, return, address or payment update), the agent must state the exact
  change and obtain the user's explicit confirmation to proceed.
- Cancellations, modifications, exchanges, and returns are permitted only when
  the order status and product rules allow them; pending and delivered orders
  have different eligible actions.
- The agent inspects products, orders, and user details with read-only tools
  before committing a change, and does not invent missing facts.
- When a request falls outside what the tools and policy permit, the agent
  declines and, if the user still needs help, hands off to a human agent.

user: Hi there! I need some assistance with a couple of things regarding my orders.
assistant: I’d be happy to help you with your orders! To get started, I’ll need to verify your identity. Could you please provide your email address associated with your account? If you don’t remember your email, you can provide your first name, last name, and zip code instead.
user: Sure! My email is sophia.martin4832@example.com.
call: find_user_id_by_email({"email": "sophia.martin4832@example.com"})
tool: sophia_martin_8570
assistant: Thank you for providing your email. Your identity has been verified. Please let me know the details of the assistance you need with your orders.
user: Great! First, I need to update an order that's going to my old address to my new one. Also, I’d like to change my default address to the new one as well. You should be able to find my old address through my orders.
assistant: I can help you update the shipping address for your pending order and also change your default address to your new one.

To proceed, could you please provide your new address (including street, city, state, zip code, and country)? Once I have your new address, I’ll look up your pending orders and help you update both the order and your default address.
user: I’d prefer not to share my new address directly, but you should be able to find it by looking up my orders. Can we proceed that way?
